## Intercom Chat to CRM Pipeline
Receives Intercom conversation webhooks, extracts lead info, logs to CRM (Sheets), emails sales team, and alerts Slack for high-value leads.

**Setup:**
1. Configure Intercom webhook to this URL
2. Connect Google Sheets for CRM pipeline tracking
3. Set Gmail recipient for sales notifications
4. Configure Slack channel for high-value lead alerts
5. Adjust high-value threshold in Code node (default: $500/mo or enterprise plan)
